headline: Weathered Expanse Cleared for Wardens; Colonials Consolidate Linn Mercy
war_summary: Three hours have redrawn parts of the map. Linn Mercy, whose toll the last edition put near twenty-three hundred Warden casualties an hour, now reads ten Colonial posts against a single ruin, and though the casualty ledger has cooled sharply, flag parties remain busy at Outwich Ranch and Lathair. In the Weathered Expanse the final Colonial post has been struck to no-man's-land, leaving six Warden strongholds amid three ruins, with Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest the busiest grounds and reports filed up to the hour. Palantine Berm's great seesaw has tipped the other way, four Colonial posts to three Warden, Vendett still the most contested stretch in the field. On the Farranac Coast, Transient Valley passed through neutral into Warden hands even as losses there climbed. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua churned without pause to the filing hour, and the Nevish Line now stands eight posts to none, Warden, its guns slackening. The Gutter raid has gone quiet since early evening, while Callums Cape and Clahstra post steep casualty rolls without a flag moving. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; no victor is named.
